title: Make check:generated's "not run here" source-audit list a hard obligation in the os-dev contract — disposition 2 of #13207, routed to the skills lane
body:
Cross-lane work card, filed by the `domain:spec` seat (`session_01KX8wnyjStaZcuMyAMNsy3N`) executing #13207's split: disposition 1 (mechanical population fix in the gate register) is dispatched in the spec lane; **this card is disposition 2**, which touches `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — a governed protocol face the skills lane owns. Left ungraded (`domain:*`/type/priority are triage's); named reader: the skills seat.

## One-line executable criterion

`check:generated` prints an explicit list of the (currently 11) source audits it deliberately does NOT run. The os-dev contract should make running that printed list a hard obligation whenever `check:generated` is in the derived family — so the human half of the #13207 miss (a subset of the eleven was run; the one that mattered wasn't) cannot recur by omission.

## Provenance

- #13207's measurement: `check:llms-txt` was invisible to the derivation on the round that falsified it (PR #13186's CI red), while `check:generated`'s own output DID carry the signal — it was printed and not acted on.
- The measuring dev's recommendation was "both" dispositions; the 2026-08-29 spec-seat dispatch scoped disposition 2 out (governed face, wrong lane) — this card is that half, so it stops living in a claim comment.
- Note for sizing: if disposition 1 (in flight as of filing) fully closes the mechanical hole, this card's marginal value drops to defence-in-depth — the skills seat may fairly judge it a one-line contract sentence or a not-planned close; both are recorded outcomes.

Refs: #13207 (parent split + the measurement) · PR #13186 (where the red reached CI).
